description: Response time and uptime for one monitor aggregated per day, with min, max, average and p95. This is the tool for reports and trends over weeks or months, and for comparing one monitor against another over the same window. When a single day looks wrong, zoom into it with get_stats_hourly.

dateFrom.description: First day to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the start of available history.

dateTo.description: Last day to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

monitorId.description: Monitor id, as returned by list_monitors.

name: get_stats_daily

totalItems.description: Total across all pages, not just this one.

title: Get daily statistics
